items.q: Is systeme.io good for someone with no technical experience running their own funnels?
items.a: Yes. Systeme.io puts a funnel builder, an email sender and a course host inside one dashboard, so a beginner does not have to connect separate tools before launching a first offer. Every funnel starts from a built-in template, and the same account sends the email a new subscriber gets and delivers the course they buy, with no third-party integration to set up. The Free plan needs no credit card, so a new seller can build and test that whole path, including one course for up to 500 students, before paying anything. Support works the same way on Free as on paid plans, through the same help center articles, not a stripped-down version. The learning curve shows up in what Free leaves out, not in how the tool works: no evergreen webinars on either of the two lowest tiers, and only one CRM pipeline, so a fast-growing sales process needs a higher plan rather than a different interface.

items.q: Can I sell physical products on systeme.io, or is it really just for courses and digital offers?
items.a: Yes, systeme.io's checkout can sell a physical product alongside a course or a digital download, and it charges 0% on that sale no matter which plan you're on. The catch is a hard cap on product variants: 50 on the Free plan, 100 on Startup, 250 on Webinar and 5,000 even on the Unlimited plan, which markets its contacts and variants as unlimited but is capped underneath by systeme.io's own plans API. That ceiling is generous for a creator selling a handful of merchandise items or course bundles alongside their main offer, and restrictive for a store with a real multi-SKU catalog, sizes and colors included. A business built primarily around physical inventory is better served by a catalog-first ecommerce platform such as Shopify or WooCommerce, both built around unlimited products and variant management rather than funnels.

items.q: Which payment processors work with systeme.io's checkout?
items.a: Systeme.io's pricing page lists checkout integrations with Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Razorpay, Flutterwave, Mercado Pago and Xendit, plus cash on delivery for physical products, so sellers outside the US and Europe have regional options as well. Systeme.io itself takes 0% of each sale on every plan, including Free, so its subscription price is the only platform fee. That does not mean payment processing is free: the processor's own rate still applies on top, such as Stripe's standard US rate of 2.9% plus 30 cents per domestic card charge, the same way it would on any platform that routes checkout through those processors. Which methods a buyer actually sees depends on the processors the seller connects and the countries those processors serve, so a seller should confirm that the processor works for their own country before building a funnel around it.

items.q: Does systeme.io include a real CRM, or just an email list?
items.a: Systeme.io includes a CRM built around pipelines, not just a contact list: the Free plan includes one pipeline, Startup five, Webinar 20 and Unlimited 100, each holding deals or leads you move between stages. That scales with the plan you're on, and it's designed to sit alongside systeme.io's own funnels and email rather than as a stand-alone sales tool. A team whose CRM needs go beyond what a funnel platform bundles in, and that wants to compare pipeline software directly against dedicated options, is better served starting from a purpose-built CRM such as Pipedrive, priced per seat rather than folded into a funnel-and-email subscription. A course creator or freelancer tracking their own leads through a simple pipeline is well covered by what's included; a sales team that needs its CRM to be the main event, not a side feature, usually is not.

items.q: Can I run an agency on systeme.io and manage several client accounts from one login?
items.a: Yes. Every systeme.io plan, including Free, allows unlimited sub-accounts, which work as separate workspaces for a second brand or a different client. The catch is that each sub-account carries exactly the same limits as whichever plan the parent account is on, not a fresh allowance of its own: an agency on the $17-a-month Startup plan can open as many client sub-accounts as it wants, but every single one is still capped at 10 funnels and 10 automation rules, the same ceiling the parent account has. Only an agency on the $97-a-month Unlimited plan gets sub-accounts with real room to work in. Systeme.io also offers a white-label option, where a reseller keeps 100% of whatever it charges a client and systeme.io takes no cut, though resale prices can't undercut systeme.io's own published price in that currency.

items.q: Can I move my existing contacts and courses over if I switch to systeme.io?
items.a: Yes, but the free version of that service only comes with certain plans. Systeme.io includes a done-for-you migration, where its team moves your contacts, funnels, courses and the rest over from your previous platform, free with the Unlimited plan on any billing schedule, and free with Startup or Webinar only if billed annually rather than month to month. A Startup or Webinar subscriber paying monthly does not get the free migration service bundled in. This matters most for a business already running an active list and a built course on another platform: moving to systeme.io on Startup or Webinar's monthly billing means either handling the move yourself or paying separately for done-for-you help, while annual billing on any plan, or Unlimited at any billing frequency, includes it at no extra cost.

items.q: Does systeme.io help me run my own affiliate program, or is that a separate purchase?
items.a: Yes, running an affiliate program for your own offers is built into every systeme.io account rather than sold as an add-on. The platform includes tools to recruit affiliates, generate their tracking links and manage commission payouts for your funnels and courses, alongside the funnel builder, email sender and course host in the same subscription. That is a different thing from systeme.io's own affiliate program for its software, which pays people who refer new systeme.io customers; the built-in tool is for running your affiliate program, for your product, inside your account. Because it ships with every plan rather than as a paid module, a course creator or freelancer who wants affiliates selling on their behalf does not need a separate tool such as a dedicated affiliate-tracking platform just to get started, though a business running a large affiliate team with complex commission tiers may eventually want more reporting depth than a bundled tool provides.
